scene: The bell rings, opening three travel gates across the misty terrace.
picture: Side-scrolling view of the stone rooftop bathhouse terrace. On the left, a tall brass spiral lift sits with its door open. The player stands left of centre in her lilac headscarf and mustard coat. In the centre, a wooden river barge floats by the dock. On the far right, a glass-roofed yellow trolley waits.
shown: a brass spiral lift with open lattice gates stands on the left
a wooden river barge moored at a stone dock in the centre
a glass-roofed yellow trolley idling on rails at the far right
